# The Art Institute of Chicago

> A world-class art museum in Chicago offering extensive collections, exhibitions, visitor experiences, and educational programs across multiple galleries and learning spaces.

The Art Institute of Chicago is a major cultural institution featuring over 5,000 years of art in its searchable collection, modern facilities like the Ryan Learning Center in the Modern Wing, and comprehensive visitor services including guided tours, events, and accessibility resources.

## Key Topics

- Exhibitions
- Collection Database
- Guided Tours
- Visitor Planning
- Accessibility
- Mobile App & Audio Tours
- Free Admission
- Events Calendar
- Family Programs
- Educator Resources
- Ticketing Information
- Museum Navigation
- Ryan Learning Center
- Modern Wing
- My Museum Tour

## Core Visit Planning

- [Home](https://www.artic.edu): Homepage for Art Institute of Chicago museum featuring exhibitions, events, and visitor information.
- [Visit](https://www.artic.edu/visit): Primary visit planning page with admission pricing, hours, directions, and parking information.
- [Events](https://www.artic.edu/events): Events calendar featuring tours, workshops, family activities, and performances.
- [Dining & Shopping](https://www.artic.edu/visit/dining-and-shopping): Information on dining options, cafes, and museum gift shop amenities.

## Exhibitions & Collections

- [Discover Art & Artists](https://www.artic.edu/collection): Searchable collection database spanning 5,000 years with artwork filters and artist directory.
- [Exhibitions](https://www.artic.edu/exhibitions): Current and upcoming exhibitions featuring contemporary art, design, and architecture.
- [Upcoming Exhibitions](https://www.artic.edu/exhibitions/upcoming): Upcoming ticketed exhibitions and collection rotations with public programs.

## Self-Guided Experiences

- [My Museum Tour](https://www.artic.edu/my-museum-tour): Tool for building custom self-guided museum tours of favorite artworks.
- [Mobile App & Audio Tours](https://www.artic.edu/visit/explore-on-your-own/mobile-app-audio-tours): Mobile app and audio tour guide featuring artist stories and multilingual content.
- [Museum Floor Plan](https://www.artic.edu/visit/explore-on-your-own/museum-floor-plan): Interactive museum floor plan and navigation guide for visitor wayfinding.
- [What to See in an Hour](https://www.artic.edu/highlights/3/what-to-see-in-an-hour): Curated one-hour tour guide highlighting iconic artworks for time-limited visitors.

## Learning & Education

- [Ryan Learning Center](https://www.artic.edu/ryan-learning-center): Hub for learning, art-making activities, and family programs in Modern Wing.
- [Educators](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/educators-2): Educator resources for classroom integration, lesson planning, and school group visits.
- [Families](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/families-2): Family visit guide featuring free admission for kids under 14 and family activities.
- [Teens](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/teens-2): Teen visitor guide with free admission for Chicago residents and youth programs.

## Visitor Support & Access

- [Accessibility](https://www.artic.edu/visit/accessibility): Comprehensive accessibility resources for visitors with disabilities and mobility needs.
- [Members](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/members): Member benefits guide covering perks, parking discounts, and exclusive access.
- [First-Time Visitors](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/first-time-visitors): Visitor guide with tips, parking info, and museum navigation for first-time guests.
- [Adult Groups](https://www.artic.edu/visit/whos-visiting/adult-groups-2): Group visit planning guide with guided tour options and self-guided recommendations.

## Optional

- [Exhibition History](https://www.artic.edu/exhibitions/history): Archive of past exhibitions and historical exhibition records database.
